verdict.rationale: The only clustering/HA claim is a single marketing line for the managed Cloud product ('native support for clusterization', 'Read High Availability') with no technical documentation of replication, sharding, or multi-node self-hosted architecture; self-hosting docs (docs-11/36) describe only a single binary with a reverse proxy and process manager, not a cluster. Hands-on community reports directly contradict smooth scaling: unpredictable RAM under heavy traffic, indexing falling behind for hours, and difficulty scaling writes (meilisearch-comm-3, meilisearch-comm-4, meilisearch-comm-13), and the largest reported deployment (80M docs) runs on a single beefy machine, not a documented cluster. Missing for 10: documented replication/sharding mechanism for self-hosted OSS, multi-node HA setup guide, and benchmarks/case studies at hundreds-of-millions-of-documents scale.
